MONDAY, MAY 18, 2026 Certiorari—Summary Disposition No. 25–253. Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa Indians, et al., Petitioners v. Michael Howe, Secretary of State of North Dakota. On petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit granted. Judgment vacated, and case remanded to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit for further consideration in light of Louisiana v. Callais, 608 U. S. ––– (2026). Justice Jackson, dissenting: This case presents only the question of Section 2's private enforceability, which our decision in Louisiana v. Callais, 608 U. S. ––– (2026), did not address. Thus I see no basis for vacating the lower court's judgment. Instead, in light of Morse v. Republican Party of Va., 517 U. S. 186 (1996), I would summarily reverse.
